domains.description: domains (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#domains=ALL).

level.description: level (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#level=TRACE).

plugins.description: Comma-separated list of plugins to load. Common values: 'ifupdown,keyfile', 'keyfile', etc. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#plugins=keyfile,ifcfg-rh).
